steps.text: Time - Unknown \ Weather - Unknown \ Visibility - Poor
Chernobog - Operation Squad E0's Location
Dr. {@nickname} Rescue Operation - Final Retreat Phase

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Damn it!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Even though we've already made it to the exit...!
Did you really think we'd let you just stroll out of Chernobog?
Don't you think it's about time for someone to wake you from your daydream?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Our commmunications have been restored, and I've contact O.P.D. They'll be joining up with us shortly!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But, this blasted...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Watch out, she's holding onto explosives!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I still can't get in touch with the recon team!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ... Who exactly are you?
I don't expect you to know who I am...
But, I know that person next to you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is Reunion... going to continue fighting us?
Hey, hey, don't be like that.
I have no love for that she-dragon, Talulah. I'm not even cut out for this goaltending business. It's a pain to have to rush over here after a long day of work.
So for the sake of future cooperation, why don't we exchange some pleasantries first?
You may simply call me... W.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I've waited a long time to see that person next to you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Doctor?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Dr.{@Nickname}......

steps.name: W
steps.text: I have a few little questions I'd like to ask {@Nickname}. Would you be so kind as to give us some... alone time?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: You're wasting your breath.

steps.name: W
steps.text: --Don't be so hasty. I have some information you might be interested in.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Actually, we just met some rather slick fellows... Quite skilled, and dressed just like you guys.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Though their camouflage might have been enough to fool Ursus, I saw right through their little trick~

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Could they be from the recon team?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm glad... that they're safe...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Little bunny, are you their leader?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm quite curious, what charm do you hold over them... so that they'd give their lives so enthusiastically and unremorsefully for you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What... are you saying...?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You heard me. None of them... will be returning to you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hey, you...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Are you really... worth sacrificing their lives over?

options: Don't worry about her. The exit's right there!
What's the point of you doing this, W?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm not done talking yet.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: W
steps.text: ... Did I make you mad?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ... You've gone too far.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Good, good... Now that's more like it.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Come at me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: W of the Reunion Movement, you've gone too far!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Every life is precious, each and every one...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is something that you'll never tarnish!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor!!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Heheh...
